annotations.text:
Every artboard carries a theme chip with four real Omarchy themes.
Switch to flexoki-light: it is a LIGHT theme, so anything that stays dark is a hard-coded colour rather than a token.

Wide layout is 180 sidebar / 340 list / rest reader, split by 1px rules at 12% foreground.
Header 48, status bar 28, window border is Hyprland's own active-border — there is no client-side titlebar.

Right-click any row for the triage menu. The reader's actions are icons with tooltips, not labels.
Clickable: pick a mailbox, open a row (it marks read and the bar count drops), type in search to filter. On the Breakpoints board the narrow frame switches list ↔ reader.
The sheet is the hand-off surface: each token names the QML expression that produces it, so the implementation reads values off Style and Color instead of copying hex out of a picture.
Compose is a WINDOW, not a pane: Hyprland tiles it beside the mailbox, so the message you are answering stays on screen instead of being covered by the form.
